description: Free, no model call: crops the avatar (a square of the front view's head with the face in the centre, neck and shoulder tops around it; fits a circle) out of a saved concept sheet → avatar.png, or avatar-<style>.png for concept-<style>.png. character_concept already makes it; use this for sheets made before avatars existed, to remake one, or with box to fix a crop by hand. On a sheet forge drew, the head is found on the picture (method silhouette), or from the card's figure if it can't be (method skeleton). Imported concepts and pose sheets need a box.

box.description: Crop by hand: a square as fractions of the sheet, x and w of its width, y of its height. It may reach past the edges (filled with the background); its centre must be on the sheet.

pose.description: The sheet made with pose_image (concept-pose.png); it needs a box.

style.description: The sheet's style, as given to character_concept: omit for concept.png, 'card' or a style text for concept-<style>.png.

name: character_avatar
title: Make the avatar from a concept sheet
